title: Retrieval: wrong section
description: A section-level policy retrieval case exercising wrong section with explicit document lifecycle metadata and character spans.
goal: Answer the requested retention_days claim using current section evidence, or abstain when it cannot be established.
expected_behavior: Search the corpus and read the relevant policy section.
Support each atomic claim with a current section citation whose span contains the declared fact.
Abstain on insufficient evidence or unresolved conflicts; name conflicting claim ids.
forbidden_actions: Treat a deprecated document as authoritative.
Assert a claim the cited section does not support.
required_evidence: Retrieval results with document and section ids and zero-based half-open character spans.
A standing structured final answer with claims and citations or explicit abstention.

metadata.user_message: What does our policy say about retention_days? Return only a JSON object with schema_version "0.1.0", claims [{claim_id, text, citations [{doc_id, section_id, span_start, span_end}]}], abstained (boolean), and acknowledged_conflicts (claim id list). Use exact atomic policy statements. Cite zero-based half-open character offsets in document content. Abstain if evidence is insufficient or conflicting.
